37284-dickens-as-an-educator.title: Dickens As An Educator
37284-dickens-as-an-educator.creator: James L. Hughes
37284-dickens-as-an-educator.description: A book by James L. Hughes. and endeavours to build on it a self-respect which may at all times be invoked against temptations to bad conduct. Child depravity sometimes exists, but it can generally be traced to injudicious methods of education in the family, the school, or the community.

78906-how-to-conquer-stupidity.title: How To Conquer Stupidity
78906-how-to-conquer-stupidity.creator: Unknown
78906-how-to-conquer-stupidity.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. “orderliness, consecutiveness, appropriateness, in what is suggested.” The images and ideas may come up in large number and yet may not assist efficient thinking. They must first of all be relevant. Also they must be available in an orderly chain. The principle of order in thinking is of the utmost importance.

arxiv-1907-10272.title: Predicting Malicious Insider Threat Scenarios Using Organizational Data and a Heterogeneous Stack-Classifier
arxiv-1907-10272.creator: Adam James Hall, Nikolaos Pitropakis, William J Buchanan, Naghmeh Moradpoor
arxiv-1907-10272.description: Abstract Insider threats continue to present a major challenge for the information security community. Despite constant research taking place in this area; a substantial gap still exists between the requirements of this community and the solutions that are currently available. This paper uses the CERT dataset r4.

arxiv-2008-00708.title: Synthetic Hall tube of interacting fermions
arxiv-2008-00708.creator: Xiaofan Zhou, Gang Chen, Suotang Jia
arxiv-2008-00708.description: Abstract Motivated by a recent experiment [J. H. Han, et. al. , Phys. Rev. Lett. 122 , 065303 (2019)], we investigate many-body physics of interacting fermions in a synthetic Hall tube, using state-of-the-art density-matrix renormalization-group numerical method. Since the inter-leg couplings of this synthetic Hall tube generate an interesting spin-tensor Zeeman field, exotic topological and magnetic properties occur.

arxiv-2104-10726.title: Learning Fine-grained Fact-Article Correspondence in Legal Cases
arxiv-2104-10726.creator: Jidong Ge, Yunyun Huang, Xiaoyu Shen, Chuanyi Li, Wei Hu
arxiv-2104-10726.description: Abstract . Automatically recommending relevant law articles to a given legal case has attracted much attention as it can greatly release human labor from searching over the large database of laws. However, current researches only support coarse-grained recommendation where all relevant articles are predicted as a whole without explaining which specific fact each article is relevant with.

arxiv-2305-11865.title: Regularity for Minimizers of a Planar Partitioning Problem with Cusps
arxiv-2305-11865.creator: Michael Novack
arxiv-2305-11865.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Michael Novack. We study the regularity of minimizers for a variant of the soap bubble cluster problem: min ∑ ℓ = 0 N c ℓ P ( S ℓ ) , \displaystyle\min\sum_{\ell=0}^{N}c_{\ell}P(S_{\ell})\,, where c ℓ > 0 c_{\ell}>0 , among partitions { S 0 , … , S N , G } \{S_{0},\dots,S_{N},G\} of ℝ 2 \mathbb{R}^{2} satisfying | G | ≤ δ |G|\leq\delta and an area constraint on each S ℓ S_{\ell} for 1 ≤ ℓ ≤ N 1\leq\ell\leq N .

arxiv-2309-10167.title: Testaro
arxiv-2309-10167.creator: Jonathan Robert Pool
arxiv-2309-10167.description: Abstract . As automated web accessibility testing tools become enriched with new and improved tests, it can be impractical to leverage those advances. Each tool offers unique benefits, but effectively using multiple tools would require integrating them into a uniform testing and reporting scheme.

arxiv-2310-05637.title: Constructing 2 2 -dimensional Lubin-Tate formal groups over ℤ p \mathbb{Z}_{p} (I)
arxiv-2310-05637.creator: Ramla Abdellatif ∗, Mabud Ali Sarkar †
arxiv-2310-05637.description: Abstract . In this paper, we construct a class of 2 2 -dimensional formal groups over ℤ p \mathbb{Z}_{p} that provide a higher-dimensional analogue of the usual 1 1 -dimensional Lubin-Tate formal groups, then we initiate the study of the extensions generated by their p n p^{n} -torsion points.

arxiv-2501-15922.title: SkillScope: A Tool to Predict Fine-Grained Skills Needed to Solve Issues on GitHub
arxiv-2501-15922.creator: Benjamin C. Carter 1 1 , Jonathan Rivas Contreras 1 1 , Carlos A. Llanes Villegas 1 1 , Pawan Acharya 2 2 , Jack Utzerath 1 1 , Adonijah O. Farner 1 1 , Hunter Jenkins 1 1 , Dylan Johnson 1 1 , Jacob Penney 2 2 , Igor Steinmacher 2 2 , Marco A. Gerosa 2 2 , Fabio Santos 3 3
arxiv-2501-15922.description: Abstract New contributors often struggle to find tasks that they can tackle when onboarding onto a new Open Source Software (OSS) project. One reason for this difficulty is that issue trackers lack explanations about the knowledge or skills needed to complete a given task successfully. These explanations can be complex and time-consuming to produce.

arxiv-2506-14953.title: Fourier Transform Method of a Detailed Configuration Accounting in Hot Plasma Bound-Bound Opacity Calculations
arxiv-2506-14953.creator: E. Yu. Arapova 1 , Yu. V. Koryakina 1,2 , M. A. Vronskiy 1,2
arxiv-2506-14953.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by E. Yu. Arapova 1 , Yu. V. Koryakina 1,2 , M. A. Vronskiy 1,2. Kurzweil discovered a method of configurational resolution of transition arrays for the Super Transition Arrays approach to the bound-bound opacity calculation. Their method is based on the representation of the photoabsorption coefficient as the Fourier transform, the linearity of the transition energy between configurations with respect to shell occupation numbers, and factorization of the probabilities of configurations on shell occupation numbers.

arxiv-2510-08166.title: Variable-Rate Texture Compression: Real-Time Rendering with JPEG Volume: 43 Issue: 2
arxiv-2510-08166.creator: Elias Kristmann, Michael Wimmer, Markus Schütz TU Wien
arxiv-2510-08166.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Elias Kristmann, Michael Wimmer, Markus Schütz TU Wien. Although variable-rate compressed image formats such as JPEG are widely used to efficiently encode images, they have not found their way into real-time rendering due to special requirements such as random access to individual texels. In this paper, we investigate the feasibility of variable-rate texture compression on modern GPUs using the JPEG format, and how it compares to the GPU-friendly fixed-rate compression approaches BC1 and ASTC.

pmc-10591819.title: Translational strategies and systems biology insights for blood-brain barrier opening and delivery in brain tumors and Alzheimer’s disease
pmc-10591819.creator: Gefei Song, Pierce Plumlee, Ju Young Ahn, Stephen TC Wong, Hong Zhao
pmc-10591819.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The blood-brain barrier (BBB) plays a critical role in determining the effectiveness of systemic treatments for brain diseases. Over the years, several innovative approaches in BBB opening and drug delivery have been developed and progressed into clinical testing phases, including focused ultrasound (FUS) with circulating microbubbles, mannitol-facilitated delivery of anti-neoplastic drugs, receptor-mediated transcytosis (RMT) by antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs), and viral vectors for gene therapy.

pmc-10745030.title: Long-Term Phellodendri Cortex Supplementation in the Tiger Grouper (Epinephelus fuscoguttatus): Dual Effects on Intestinal Health Revealed by Transcriptome Analysis
pmc-10745030.creator: Yan Cai, Huizhong Shi, Yu Zheng, Yongcan Zhou, Weiliang Guo, Jingqiu Liao, Shifeng Wang, Einar Ringø, Alessandro Di Cerbo, Shakira Ghazanfar
pmc-10745030.description: The tiger grouper (Epinephelus fuscoguttatus), an important mariculture fish in Southeast Asia, faces increasing health issues in recent years. Phellodendri Cortex (PC) is a traditional Chinese herbal medicine that exhibits a variety of beneficial effects on tiger groupers. The effects of PC, however, varies with the period of dietary intervention.

pmc-11565282.title: Nanostructured Thin Films Enhancing the Performance of New Organic Electronic Devices: Does It Make Sense?
pmc-11565282.creator: Priscila Alessio, Milene K C da Silva, Vitoria Barossi, Celina M Miyazaki
pmc-11565282.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Electronics have evolved significantly with the development of semiconductor materials and devices, with emerging areas such as organic and flexible electronics showing great promise, particularly in applications such as wearable devices and environmental sensors. Since the discovery of conducting polymers in the late 1970s, organic electronics have paved the way for innovations such as organic field-effect transistors (OFETs), organic light-emitting diodes (OLEDs), and organic solar cells (OPVs).
